title: Estimating the Partially Linear Zero-Inflated Poisson Regression Model: a Robust Approach Using a EM-like Algorithm
summary: Count data with an excessive number of zeros frequently arise in fields such as economics, medicine, and public health. Traditional count models often fail to adequately handle such data, especially when the relationship between the response and some predictors is nonlinear. To overcome these limitations, the partially linear zero-inflated Poisson (PLZIP) model has been proposed as a flexible alternative.
